# Upstream OTLP regression fixtures

`openinference.otlp.json` and `openllmetry.otlp.json` are the `in.json` samples
from [genai-interlingua](https://github.com/Grace/genai-interlingua/tree/ece3efa13745f8fe0a8b596f162118192d85d22a/testdata),
commit `ece3efa13745f8fe0a8b596f162118192d85d22a`.

They are used as input fixtures only. BANDITS does not copy Interlingua's
normalization algorithm. The upstream project is Apache-2.0; its license is
included here.
